an issuer-reported or covenant leverage ratio. Do not silently treat all cash as

deducted from that proxy (base OCF already includes base cash interest/tax/WC);

## Findings

CP-2/CP-1A identify aircraft utilization, airline economics, OEM production and defense budgets as demand drivers, with labor/material/supply constraints potentially preventing cost flex. Receivables/inventory absorption could accelerate this pathway but is not separately modeled. Hedge transitions expose cash-interest sensitivity; July facility expiry introduces a dated funding question that a static ratio cannot answer. A real failure point would require inaccessible liquidity, inability to fund obligations or failed renewal/refinancing—not merely crossing a watch.

## Calculations

K supplies a new deterministic calculation, not a model-loop Python execution or native-owner acceptance. Its F/code hashes match the supplied identities above. The direct BaseOperands approach bypasses the native nine-T4.10-fact offered-period and reported-ratio gates; no typed financial facts were fabricated. Static formulas are E′=E(1−s), I′=I(1+k), P′=P−Es−Ik; total leverage D/E′, mechanical net leverage (D−C)/E′, coverage E′/I′ and proxy/debt P′/D. P denotes OCF-less-capex proxy, never sustainable or issuer-defined FCF. Only incremental interest is deducted: base OCF already includes base cash interest, taxes and working capital.

## Gaps

Limitations: This is a bounded static screen plus historical event reconstruction, not a forecast, current liquidity assessment, covenant opinion, rating, PD estimate, recovery or refinancing execution conclusion. There is no tax shield, working-capital/capex response or modeled distribution/acquisition response; the one-for-one earnings-to-proxy reduction is assumed. Reported cash is not established unrestricted cash. No netting or aggregation of overlapping derivative notionals establishes coverage. No later quarter or realised 2025 result is used. Reading extracted text does not constitute visual verification. Confidence remains Medium and below High while the two Critical CP-1A/CP-2 gaps persist.
